scope: Original Rocq/MetaRocq/Peregrine bootstrap; excludes canonical Rust-native formalization

rocq-stdlib.role: separate source repository for the already-required rocq-stdlib.9.0.0

checker.policy: Retain the real checker and its metatheory. A closed verified guard implementation and source-to-machine refinement remain required.

coverage_policy.source_vendoring: Every tracked source file, including original licenses and non-Gallina files, is present in an independent pinned worktree inside the MetaRocq source bundle.
coverage_policy.module_names: Build load paths identify modules only; they do not select or accept theorems.
coverage_policy.proof_roots: Rocq tmQuoteModule emits every global reference for every declared module. Missing modules or open variables block quotation.
coverage_policy.unmapped_gallina: Report every file lacking a declared load path. Full source coverage cannot be claimed while any remain.
coverage_policy.non_gallina: Keep original source bytes. They are not silently treated as extracted Gallina or as certified kernel code.
coverage_policy.certification: Source inventory and vendoring receipts never constitute proof acceptance.
